body.name: \(\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)\)
body.construction:
\[
 \Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)=
 \{T_\pi=(B_\pi^{(a)})_{a\in M}:\pi\in\Pi_G(\mathcal O_G)\},
 \qquad N_{\mathrm{out}}=|\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)|,
\]
where set braces remove numerical duplicates.  This is the published-class coefficient-tuple estimand; \(\Pi_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)\) remains the separately reported component-aligned refinement.
